trade-world-economy-advantage.alt: Two invented countries. In one day of work, Country A makes 6 tonnes of rice or 3 bikes; Country B makes 2 tonnes of rice or 2 bikes. So in A one bike costs 2 tonnes of rice and a tonne of rice costs half a bike; in B one bike costs 1 tonne of rice and a tonne of rice costs 1 bike. A gives up less to make rice, so A makes rice; B gives up less to make bikes, so B makes bikes.
